args.text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

Hi Pree, I went through #central-team and found three Marrow Agrisupply sites mentioned:

1. *Eastbank*: Hollis, 9 Jun 2026, 10:46 AM. Ticket PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached. The file labels doors E1/E2 but their booking sheet uses 01/02, so that needs sorting out before anyone reimports.
2. *Pine Crossing*: you, 9 Jun 2026, 10:48 AM. The morning receiver only sees the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it with the store login.
3. *Wichita store*: you, 2 Jul 2025, 9:21 AM. You mentioned the 8am check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher, right after Tobias said your Zoom was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours. That's the only link to Marrow, so I'm reading it as a Marrow site, but you'd know better.

Two caveats:
• The Tulsa hub in the same 2 Jul 2025 thread belongs to Tansley Parcel (Lev Arkadin), not Marrow, so I left it out.
• Hollis's 9 Jun post says *several* new stores are rolling out, and three tracker rows just said "waiting." But the full store list was never posted in the channel, so these three are all I can find there.
